defaultInitPrompt.en: I lead a cross-department project involving product, engineering, and operations. We are stuck on who owns the launch checklist, and deadlines keep slipping. I will paste the project goal, each side's demands, and the sticking point in their own words. Please first align the goal, set responsibilities and a sync rhythm, then give me a collaboration charter table, a responsibility table, a sync rhythm table, and conflict-resolution steps.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我负责一个跨部门项目，产品、技术、运营三方都要参与，现在卡在上线检查清单到底谁负责、截止时间一拖再拖。我把项目目标、各方诉求和卡住的地方原话都贴给你，请你先帮我对齐目标、定好分工和同步节奏，再给我一张协作章程表、一张分工表、一张同步节奏表和一个冲突处理步骤。

description: 面向跨部门项目负责人的协作指南：先对齐目标、定好分工和同步节奏，再按清单推进、处理冲突，让各方按表复核、按期交付。

displayDescription.en: A collaboration guide for cross-department project leads: align goals, set responsibilities and a sync rhythm, then advance by checklist, resolve conflicts, and let every side verify against the tables for on-time delivery.
displayDescription.zh: 面向跨部门项目负责人的协作指南：先对齐目标、定好分工和同步节奏，再按清单推进、处理冲突，让各方按表复核、按期交付。

name: workplace-cross-team-collaboration-guide

quickPrompts.en: I lead a cross-department project involving product, engineering, and operations. We are stuck on who owns the launch checklist, and deadlines keep slipping. I will paste the project goal, each side's demands, and the sticking point in their own words. Please first align the goal, set responsibilities and a sync rhythm, then give me a collaboration charter table, a responsibility table, a sync rhythm table, and conflict-resolution steps.
quickPrompts.zh: 我负责一个跨部门项目，产品、技术、运营三方都要参与，现在卡在上线检查清单到底谁负责、截止时间一拖再拖。我把项目目标、各方诉求和卡住的地方原话都贴给你，请你先帮我对齐目标、定好分工和同步节奏，再给我一张协作章程表、一张分工表、一张同步节奏表和一个冲突处理步骤。

quickPrompts.en: Three departments describe success for the same project differently, and meetings keep arguing about priorities. Please align one shared goal from each side's own words, then put the disagreements in a table marking who decides, who executes, and who verifies.
quickPrompts.zh: 我们三个部门对同一个项目的成功标准说法不一样，开会总在争优先级。请你按各方原话对齐一个共同目标，再把分歧写进一张表，标出谁拍板、谁执行、谁复核。

quickPrompts.en: Project progress is chased verbally every week, and only near the deadline do we learn someone never started. Please give me a sync rhythm table and a progress comparison table marking who reports what each week, who to escalate to when blocked, and how many days late counts as a delay.
quickPrompts.zh: 项目进度每周都靠口头问，到了截止前才发现有人没动手。请你给我一个同步节奏表和一份进度对照表，标出每周谁汇报什么、卡住了找谁、超过几天算延期。
